answer: Material fingerprint identity binding. Each agent key enrolls with a fingerprint from one distinct physical token, such as a crystal with random defects. A shale fragment’s unique grain is another valid token form. At challenge, a tamper-resistant reader signs the measured delta from the enrolled pattern; duplicate fingerprints are rejected by the ledger. An attacker must acquire, ship, and custody one separate token per identity, plus a reader, so each sybil pays physical material and handling cost.
